- [FACT] User is associated with Offploy, a social enterprise.
- [FACT] Offploy has a vision of a world where everyone feels safe from crime.
- [FACT] Offploy offers a suite of Employer Services to support employers in hiring people with convictions.
- [FACT] Offploy's services include tailored training, coaching, and consultancy.
- [FACT] Offploy's training can be delivered face-to-face or online.
- [FACT] Offploy's core offering is the "Seven Steps to safe and sustainable recruitment."
- [FACT] The course designed by Offploy consists of seven modules.
- [FACT] The seven modules are: 
  1. Getting the culture right 
  2. Recruitment Procedures and Policy Development
  3. Risk Management (Role and Candidate)
  4. Marketing Your Vacancies Appropriately and Strategically
  5. Interviews, Disclosure and Vetting
  6. Onboarding, Additional Support and Saying ‘No’ 
  7. Onboarding, Additional Support and Saying ‘No’ 
- [FACT] Each module consists of several objectives to support employers in recruiting people with convictions.
- [FACT] Offploy delivers objectives through three methods: Consult, Train, and Support.
